title: Kondalalo (Uyar Malaiyo Telugu) – Asha Ashirwadh Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: గాఢాంధ కారములో నీవే నా గుడారము నీవే ఆశ్రయము
పచ్చికగల చోట్ల పరుండజేయును నీవే నా బలము
english: Ghaadaandha kaaramulo neeve naa gudaaramu neeve aasrayamu
pachikagala chotla parundajeyunu neeve naa balamu
ninnu nenu aaraadhinchedhanu naa yesu deva
intro: Kondalalo is the latest Christian Telugu Worship song translated from popular Tamil christian song, Uyar Malaiyo written and released by Tamil Christian Gospel Singer, Pastor John Jebaraj on 25 June, 2019. This song was translated and sung by Asha Ashirwadh. This song was released on October 05, 2021 through Asha Ashirwadh YouTube channel.
